title: Kang Ho-dong exits as The Great Escape premieres new urban ghost stories season
text:
Kang Ho-dong exits as The Great Escape premieres new urban ghost stories season - CHOSUNBIZ 
 2026년 10월 29일(목) Industry Finance Real Estate IT Retail Science Policy Society International Entertainment Culture Sports English Entertainment Kang Ho-dong exits as The Great Escape premieres new urban ghost stories season 
 입력 2026.10.28. 09:00 조선비즈 구글 검색 먼저 보기 With Kang Ho-dong, who participated in every series, absent, a new series of 'The Great Escape' titled "urban ghost stories" is newly unveiled.
 'The Great Escape: urban ghost stories' will premiere Dec. 2 (Wed) at 6 p.m., writing a new legend.
 The TVING original 'The Great Escape: urban ghost stories' is an extreme escape adventure set against bizarre urban ghost stories. As the new season of Korea's only large-scale escape variety show 'The Great Escape', Kim Jongmin, Kim Dong-hyun, Shin Dong, Yoo Byungjae, Ko Kyung-pyo and Seungkwan — escape artists famous for being scaredy-cats — become trapped within the ghost stories and embark on a journey fighting to escape amid heightened tension.
 With the confirmed premiere at 6 p.m. on Dec. 2 (Wed), the released teaser poster captures the chilling atmosphere of 'The Great Escape: urban ghost stories', drawing attention. All of the mysterious locations viewed through CCTV emanate an eerie aura, sparking curiosity about what events will await the escape artists.
 In particular, unidentified silhouettes, a chilling hand emerging from an opened manhole cover, broken glass and tiles create an ominous atmosphere. The phrase "I want to get out, like crazy" seems to represent the feelings of the six cowardly escape artists trapped in the ghost stories, raising expectations for a heart-stopping plot, unpredictable twists, thrilling deductions and satisfying relief in the new season.
 Also, with original members Kim Jongmin and Shin Dong returning and new member Seungkwan joining this time, the members' novel relationships are expected to amplify the fun. The intermittent genius who finds crucial clues Kim Jongmin, the owner of sharp senses and insight Shin Dong, the member optimized for physical missions Kim Dong-hyun, the storyteller Yoo Byungjae, the passionate supporter and overimmerser Ko Kyung-pyo, and Seungkwan, who possesses extreme affability and variety skills — their performances and chemistry are anticipated.
 Meanwhile, 'The Great Escape' began with season 1 in 2018, and Kang Ho-dong had served as the central axis leading the program alongside the members as their leader since then. He participated through season 4 and received much love from viewers. However, he officially announced he would not participate in this 'The Great Escape: urban ghost stories', and his departure after eight years has increased fans' regrets.
 Regarding this, Kang Ho-dong passed the baton to his juniors so the program could draw a new picture and sent them warm support. "Every moment of 'The Great Escape' was great pleasure and happiness to me," he said, "I believe this season's colleagues and juniors, who have imagination and wisdom greater than mine, will do their best for 'The Great Escape' to succeed, and finally I want to hint that 'clues exist everywhere'" as he offered advice to his juniors.
